verdict.rationale: Cerebras Inference is an API-first product with an extensively documented public REST API. The docs cover a quickstart, OpenAI-compatible endpoints, streaming, tool calling, structured outputs, a Batch API and a management API, and there are official Python and Node SDKs. Hands-on community use (the llm-cerebras plugin with a cloud API key) independently confirms it works. Missing for 10: no machine-readable OpenAPI/Swagger spec was found (all probe paths returned 404).

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API
